title: Object Storage: cool review — corrected net target
content:
For Object Storage cool review, subtract the included allowance from the sum of measured and signed reversal volume, then floor at zero. Multiply that remaining volume by the cool-storage rate and round only the net target half-up to the tier monetary precision decimal places.

## Basis Q&A

What determines cool review in this situation? Subtract the included allowance from the sum of measured and signed reversal volume, then floor at zero. Multiply that remaining volume by the cool-storage rate and round only the net target half-up to the tier monetary precision decimal places.

## Hypothetical cool review — corrected net target case

For this cool review — corrected net target example, assume hypothetical measured volume 180 GB-month, signed reversals negative 20 GB-month, included allowance 70 GB-month and rate USD 0.014 per GB-month. Subtracting the allowance after combining measurements and reversals leaves 90 GB-month. The net target is USD 1.26, rounded only at that monetary outcome.
